title: RootRevocationProduction
description: A 2-of-3-signed revocation record for the BANZA open financial protocol root, produced under the 2-of-3 custody model. Public material only: the root id, the revoked key id, the reason, the effective date, at least 2 of 3 custodian signatures, and the threshold. NO private key, seed or passphrase appears here. Because the model is 2-of-3, revoking one key does not destroy the root: the two remaining custodians can still sign, and a rotation can introduce a replacement key. Revocation is a root-scope action (never a payment, operator or fund action). Fewer than 2 signatures yields M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_BLOCKED_BY_THRESHOLD. Status is computed in Rust by engines/banza-root-ceremony :: validate_root_ceremony, never in TypeScript.
_authority: Root Trust Ceremony (2-of-3 offline custody, docs/governance PKI trust model)
_boundary: Root trust for the BANZA open financial protocol. The root does NOT authorise payment services, does NOT create operators, does NOT issue licences, does NOT move/settle/hold funds, and does NOT replace operator regulatory authorisation. BANZA remains an open financial protocol; PSPs/banks/authorised operators are separate entities that implement it.

root_id.description: The protocol root of trust whose key is being revoked.

revoked_key_id.description: The root key id being revoked (e.g. 'root-key-B').

reason.description: Why the key is being revoked. Compromise of one key does not compromise the whole root under 2-of-3.

signatures.description: Custodian signatures authorising the revocation. At least 2 of 3 required (M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_BLOCKED_BY_THRESHOLD if fewer). The revoked key's own signature does not count toward the threshold.

key_id.description: Root key id that produced this signature.

signature.description: Detached signature over the canonical revocation bytes (base64url, ed25519). Public material.
